text:
Priya (VP Eng): thanks for the runtime segment. quick Q: what's the canary plan for the new attention-kernel rewrite and how will it interact with batching configs?
Mateo (Runtime): high level: we'll run a staged canary focused on a single model family. Stage 1: internal canary on low-traffic pool (5% traffic) for 72h. Stage 2: broaden to 25% with a/b batching tweaks. Stage 3: GA if no regressions.
Jin (Infra): ops detail: need a dedicated canary pool with fixed node sizes; no autoscaler for stage 1. we also want a pre-warm job that simulates typical prefix distributions.
Lee (SRE): what are the kill-switch metrics? last kernel rollout had a silent p99 spike.
Nora (Bench): propose the following guardrails: 1) p50/p95/p99 latency delta vs baseline, 2) error-rate, 3) tail GPU utilization, 4) batch-fill-time. thresholds: p95 regression >10% OR p99 >15% => rollback.
Mateo (Runtime): agreed. also adding cache/memory churn metric because the new kernel uses a different scratch allocation pattern.
Sara (Product): customers will want a per-route opt-in. can we support toggling the new kernel per-route during canary?
Mateo (Runtime): yes — runtime flag per route: kernel_variant: "legacy" | "attention-v2". default remains legacy for GA until rollout completes.
Priya (VP Eng): cost question: does attention-v2 change token cost for hosted API?
Mateo (Runtime): token CPU/GPU ms drops ~7-12% on avg, but some seq-len combos worsen by 3-5% due to setup overhead. overall expect ~8% unit cost reduction for typical workloads.
Jin (Infra): action: I'll create canary pool and setup warmers. ETA tomorrow EOD.
Lee (SRE): action: I'll add automated rollback that flips route flags and triggers deploy. need PR for the healthcheck endpoint.
Mateo (Runtime): I'll add a /health/kernel-check endpoint that emits {ok, kernel_variant, recent_p95_ms, batch_fill_ms}.
Nora (Bench): bench plan: run perf harness with sampled real prefixes plus synthetic long-seq tails. will post CSVs.
Priya (VP Eng): what about batcher tuning? do we apply new batch config during canary or keep existing?
Mateo (Runtime): start with existing batch config; stage 2 will try increased max_batch_size (+25%) and a slightly higher latency_target_ms to measure cost/latency tradeoffs.
Sara (Product): we should prepare two recommended configs in docs: "conservative" and "throughput-optimized". link to those in the public notes.
Lee (SRE): monitoring note: add an alert for batch_fill_time > 200ms for two consecutive mins. also alert on GPU mem alloc failure spikes.
OpsBot: Canary job scheduled by Jin on 2026-04-04T03:30:00Z (automated).
Mateo (Runtime): rollout snippet for per-route flag (example):
```
route: /chat/assistant
kernel_variant: "attention-v2"
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 96
  latency_target_ms: 150
canary: true
```
Mateo (Runtime): also the runtime will fallback to legacy variant automatically on error code 0xE7 (kernel-crash) with a 10s cooldown to avoid thundering restarts.
Priya (VP Eng): please quantify expected SLO deltas in the canary doc (p50/p95/p99) and include cost delta estimates.
Nora (Bench): initial numbers: p50 -6ms, p95 -12ms, p99 -18ms on 1024 context for chat models; cost delta ~-9%. will refine with more runs.
Sara (Product): I'll draft the customer-facing note and include a FAQ for rollback and per-route opt-in.
Jin (Infra): once stage1 is green, I'll post stage2 window. need sign-off from Priya for 25% expansion.
Priya (VP Eng): sign-off pending the bench CSVs + SRE sign-off on alerts.
Lee (SRE): will review once Nora posts data. also please add a short rollback playbook to the canary doc.
Mateo (Runtime): will attach RFC+benchmarks and the health endpoint PR here when ready.
Priya (VP Eng): thanks. please keep updates concise in this thread. :thumbsup:
Mateo (Runtime): will update. (thumbsup)
